releases.name: Wrenny Lee: Witch-for-Hire!
releases.summary: A short visual novel comedy about Wrenny, a hard-working witch! The freelance life is anything but magical!

releases.name: My Little Hell
releases.summary: This place is his little hell. After everything that was done, he will spend as much time here as his personal devil wishes. The only problem is that his brain turned completely to mush. He doesn’t remember what happened. He doesn’t even remember his own name.

releases.name: Smoke Keeper
releases.summary: A cozy first-person organizing simulator where you sort 4,316 scattered items throughout a two-storey Victorian tobacconist. Put every item on its proper shelf, unlock helpful skills, and restore perfect order at your own pace—or race the clock.

releases.name: Knode: Untangle & Connect
releases.summary: Untangle knots and connect cables on a mysterious concrete platform in the middle of the ocean. But you’re not alone. The AI running the testing program seems to want to be your friend..

releases.name: Kibo to Yume
releases.summary: A revolutionary RPG with a mind-blowing plot, a humorous touch and..... a soundtrack so good, you can't focus on playing the game...

releases.name: Raw Egg Peeling
releases.summary: A relaxing game about peeling an egg.

releases.name: Low Space Race
releases.summary: Wars have ruined the whole country and your people are crying out Heroes!Now the Great Hero, Lady Olivia appears to ask for help to end the war! Please join her and bring your citizens out of darkness.In order to create the most powerful kingdom and rule the land, you need to build greater buildings, plunder more resources, train mightier troops and become invincible! It's gonna be a lot of fun and lets you play online with thousands of players all over the world.Amazing Game Features:? Construct higher-level buildings and grow the greater city? Train more powerful armies to win the wars? Attack other players to plunder resources? Do researches and learn advance magics? Join an alliance and enjoy more privileges? Play online with other players on the map? Win useful items for free each dayYou will feel so proud to see your city become the greatest! So join the game and have fun!

releases.name: Museologist: Tidy Up the Museum!
releases.summary: Museologist: Tidy Up the Museum! A single-player simulation. The whole collection has fallen apart. Find where each fragment belongs, piece it back together like a puzzle, and restore 428 objects from 3,105 scattered pieces.

releases.name: The Ball Just Won't Stay Up
releases.summary: Just a brick breaker — why so serious? It's not about catching. Craft screen-clearing builds from ball, paddle, and brick synergies. Each run, mix and match to turn the screen into a fireworks show.

releases.name: VHS Chaos
releases.summary: Look at the clip and don't even blink, the answer will reveal itself!You just received a new challenge from your friend, now it's the time to see who is smarter. View the beautiful short video and outsmart an answer. If you got it you'll know!Become an expert, start producing your own blinks and share them with your friends. If they'll solve them, their friends will get a chance to compete as well. The more people will play your blinks the more points you get."It's smart, it's fun, and it's lovely…"  R.F.Y. Game Features·        Easy log in via Facebook.·         Upon landing get a variety of the best blinks available.·         Have fun with your friends and solve their riddles.·         Concentrate only on categories you have interest in.·         Look on what your friends are playing and try as well.·         Produce your own blinks a share them with your friends.·         Save what you liked and play it again when you desire.

releases.name: WashMate
releases.summary: Play the fastest racquet sport in the world! Real Badminton is the ultimate 3D badminton game on your iPhone & iPod Touch!You'll need lightning-quick reflexes, inch-perfect netplays and devastating jump smashes to challenge the world's top shuttlers. Come on, stepon court now!Game features:- 8 players from 8 different countries- 5 different badminton courts- Quick matches for that badminton quick fix- Match configuration system- Game Center achievements to test your mettle - 4 World class tournaments- 3 Challenge minigames- Share your victory screens with friends on Facebook and Twitter- Interactive tutorial system- Realistic shuttlecock physicsReal Badminton - the REAL badminton game on the App Store!

releases.name: Immortal Chess
releases.summary: Chess game with classes, Mana, spells, traps and skills. Build your strategy, disrupt your opponent and compete across platforms in tactical matches. Choose the class that suits best your play style.

releases.name: The Crooked Hand
releases.summary: Collaborate to make music for the next episode of Hook Ups.  Lay down an instrument and send your track to a collaborator to add another. Four instruments can be added to each track before it is submitted to the Hook Ups team. ***Share your tracks on SoundCloud and Facebook. ***New instruments loaded periodically. ***Watch the cartoons at http://www.facebook.com/hookupstv

releases.name: Puzzle Arcade Pals
releases.summary: A wholesome, ad-free puzzle collection designed specifically for kids. Featuring Spot the Difference, Jigsaw Puzzles, and classic Brick Breaker with charming themes, zero microtransactions, and simple, screen-safe gameplay.

releases.name: Scratch Tickets With Your Friends
releases.summary: Raise your monster to be the best. Train them to improve strength, speed and accuracy to battle in arenas. In arenas you capture monsters to breed new, stronger monsters to advance through all the arenas. The unique lifespan only allows you to have each monster for a maximum of 4 days. In this time you raise it as best you can and battle as far as you can before you breed it to make a strong baby to go further then the parents.Follow me at http:www.facebook.com/monstergenerations

releases.name: Mortality... Please
releases.summary: Any warehouse manager would kill for a heavy-duty hero like this to move the goods. So many crates to stack, so little time. But when you happen to have a forklift with a magnetic arm, moving boxes goes a lot faster. Unfortunately, warehouses of the future can be tricky to navigate. Solve this puzzle game's secrets to load up the truck on each level. Forklifts are easy to operate...right? The packages are ready to be loaded onto the truck°™all you have to do is get them there. Move your loader, pick up the boxes, and stack them on the truck to succeed in this puzzle game. It°Øs not as easy as it sounds°™solve sequence codes, avoid obstacles and treat delicate packages carefully! Complete each taxing task to become the ultimate loader. The madcap machine is back with many more physics puzzles to solve. These trucks ain°Øt gonna load themselves! Break out a can of elbow grease and start moving the crates.

releases.name: Deep Trouble: A Fishing RPG
releases.summary: "Want to hone your item-crafting knowledge skills? Are you the master when it comes to item knowledge in LoL? Can't currently play the game but wanna pass some time in the LoL universe? Then this game is absolutely for you! In this game you'll have every single item in the game presented to you, and you'll have to craft them correctly to gain points and go up in the rankings. You can compete with your friends too! Do you think you're the master crafter? Then beat every single one of your friends!" releases.name: Cozy Farm: Tidy Up!
releases.summary: How many bottles can you open within 10 seconds?“Bottle opening -- the fight of the century!!! A matter of one second!!”.................................................................................- Simple manipulation    This game requires only one means of control,i.e., touch and slide. You need to employ a precise, quick technique of touch and slide  that will make you a champion in bottle opening.     The rules are simple: Join as if you are participating in an actual “master bottle opening championship competition”   in a real arena.  After the start signal, using your finger as opener, perform precise, quick touch and slide up to open as many bottles as possible within 10 seconds. Pong! Pong! Pong! Those bottle lids will fly away along with a light, swift, jingling sound. Here, what matters is that you select only the bottles labeled with the same Pilo character as that on the left of the screen. Once all of the bottles on the screen are opened, touch and slide with your finger from left to right on the screen to bring in a new set of bottles.  .................................................................................- Game mode - Multiple players: You can compete with other players in bottle opening via the game center. -3. Level-up system    The coins you obtained can be used to purchase other higher-level bottle openers.   Level-up 1 (1,000 coins) Bronze opener: Opening one bottle is equivalent to opening two bottles.    Level-up 2 (5,000 coins) Silver opener: Opening one bottle is equivalent to opening three.    Level-up 3 (10,000 coins) Gold opener: Opening one bottle is equivalent to opening four.    Level-up 4 (50,000 coins) Master opener: Opening one bottle is equivalent to opening five. ................................................................................- Universal App: This App is a universal app that you can use on both iPhones and iPads with one-time purchase.................................................................................-5. releases.name: Home D.O.
releases.summary: Up to four medical professionals race around a top-down hospital, curing ape patients through twenty grotesque and unconventional mini-games. Get the highest score in this free-for-all multiplayer party game.

releases.name: Tab-lings
releases.summary: A simple, amazingly addictive, game for word lovers! *There's a word you have to guess. There are 4 coins that contain hints. These word hints are related in some way. Use the hints to guess the word and earn more coins!Stumped on a word? Spend some coins to use helpers. They can reveal a letter in the word, show the definition of the word, or when really stumped, reveal the word.If you love word games, you will find HeyWords quick to learn and a lot of fun!What are you waiting for…get your WORD on!

releases.name: Killdozer
releases.summary: Destroy the town that screwed you over! Killdozer is an action roguelike where your goal is to destroy a town while surviving a police onslaught. Unlock items and upgrades along the way to build your Killdozer into the ultimate destruction machine.

releases.name: Boothill
releases.summary: No fat, zero calories cookies rich in warmth and enjoyment. Decorate them as you wish. Lots of fun, no cleaning afterwards. No harm for the waist! The app is a lite version with a limited access to the content; it has full functionality (save, email, Facebook) so you can try the look and feel for free. With this version, you get:- 3 cookies (one type, fir, in 3 colours); - 2 types of decorations (7 flowers + endless number of smiles in 8 colours);- two letters A and N (both upper case and lower case) in 8 colours; - wonderful music, fun tiger and an ever neat kitchen. The Full version of this app is GREAT in many ways: - Create lovely personalized cookies perfect for any occasion you may think of: for wedding, birthday, Mother's Day, Christmas, party, invitation, if you want to cheer up a friend, etc.; - Perfect gift for girls of all ages; - For kids' fine motor skills development; may be recommended for kids with retardation; - For education: practice colors, shapes and letters in composing all you friends and relative names with you kids; - For creativity and immagination development; - For fun. There is an animated trash bin and there is a tiger living in the shelf. His name is Aphona, after the boy who has voiced him. Have fun, share it with your dear ones (e-mail) and with the whole wolrd (Facebook)! Full version contains everything + all the future updates for free; it's equal to our Special Offer.SPECIAL OFFER: for your convenience, we have added the option "I want everything!" which is equal to the full version. Good bargain!Do not miss our next update that we are cooking right now!
